decisions.reason: Because this formwork profile system is close to the firm's existing modular formwork and factory-equipment knowledge and was already given its own page, management would expect strong learning and improvement potential from its existing engineering and R&D base.

Because the automated concrete distributor flow control directly builds on the firm's automation and process-control capabilities, the firm can readily interpret early market feedback and refine it through in-house R&D.

Because the shuttering magnet block is closely related to the firm's established formwork offer, it fits the firm's prior knowledge and can be supported efficiently even if its website presence was still limited in the launch year.

Because the magnetic formwork strips are close to the established product architecture and were important enough to receive their own page, they are a good candidate for retention and incremental improvement.

Because this magnetic formwork component is tightly connected to the firm's existing solutions and visible as a standalone offering, the firm has high absorptive capacity to commercialise and improve it.

Because this magnetic formwork component is close to the firm's core know-how, management would typically keep it at this early stage and use accumulated market and technical learning before considering withdrawal.
